parameters: PXE Faceset
Hello there new player! Welcome to the
beautiful island of Xanadu!\.
I am your PXE or Personal Xanadu Expert!
Original Player Face
PXE...\.Pixie. Very funny.
PXE Faceset
Is it?\. Anyway, I'm an Artificial
Intelligence designed to help you
understand and interact with the
wonderful world of MOnline!
PXE Faceset
But first of all, I need your name!
PXE Faceset
Hello there \n[1]!\.
It's very nice to meet you!
Original Player Face
Quick question, how come I look like my
real self? Is it really an MMO without
a character creator?
PXE Faceset
Your physical appearance was scanned in
by your headset when you first logged in.
This is to create a bigger emotional
connection between player and character.
PXE Faceset
But my creators would like to inform
you that Appearance Alter packs are
available from the ingame store for
a reasonable price!
Original Player Face
Microtransactions, my favourite.
Is that all?
PXE Faceset
In order to finalise your registration
you'll need to agree to the terms and
conditions. Would you like to read
through them?
Original Player Face
Obviously, I don't want to be signing
away my soul.
PXE Faceset
Very well. Please wait while I load
the terms and conditions.
